text:
maya: Hey team — customer (acct: acct_0A8EU, region: NO) says their EU promo code didn't apply on signup. They selected 'NOK' as billing currency and checkout showed full price + 25% VAT, promo rejected. Can someone triage?

jeff: Can you paste the promo code & the API/UI request they used? Also any error from our side?

maya: Promo code: EUROTRIAL23. Repro steps from support: 1) Create acct with country=NO, currency=NOK 2) Start trial via /signup 3) Apply promo in UI 4) Error shows: "Promo not eligible".

sophie: I repro'ed in stage. Sending the curl I used:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/apply_promo \n -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_test_xxx' \n -d '{"account_id":"acct_0A8EU","promo":"EUROTRIAL23","currency":"NOK","items":[{"sku":"starter","amount":49.00,"quantity":1}],"country":"NO"}'
```
Response:```json
{
  "ok": false,
  "error": "promo_ineligible",
  "reason": "threshold_not_met_after_tax",
  "details": {"subtotal": 49.00, "tax": 12.25, "total": 61.25, "currency": "NOK"}
}
```

luis: Thanks. Looks like our eligibility check is comparing promo.min_amount to the invoice total (subtotal + tax) for orders where tax is added at checkout. For many EU customers tax is required and should be excluded from the promo threshold. That explains why a 49 NOK item (>= promo min 40 EUR equiv) is failing once VAT is added.

jeff: Hmm — the rule should use pre-tax subtotal converted to promo currency, not total-with-tax. Do we have any legacy code path that uses invoice.total instead of subtotal?

luis: Yes — older flow for local currencies used invoice.total to avoid surprises in locales where prices are tax-inclusive. Edge case: Norway stores prices exclusive of VAT in the API but UI adds VAT later. In mixed flows (customer picks local currency that the merchant system reports as tax-inclusive/exclusive) our check sometimes mixes them up.

maya: Customer is asking for quick fix / credit. Can we grant trial credits while eng fixes the eligibility logic?

jeff: I can push a short-lived guard: for any promo tagged as "eu-exempt-tax", compute eligibility using line_items.subtotal_excluding_tax -> convert to promo currency using fixed rate service -> then compare to promo.min_amount. This should be a small change in billing-service before the next deploy.

sophie: Workaround for this customer: manually apply promo via admin console or grant credits. Steps I took in console: Admin -> Accounts -> acct_0A8EU -> Promotions -> Apply promo EUROTRIAL23 (succeeded when forced). But that bypasses eligibility checks.

luis: I'll approve a manual 30 EUR-equivalent credit for acct_0A8EU now and flag for audit. Doing: `grant_credit acct_0A8EU 30 EUR reason:"promo_tax-edgecase"`

billing-bot: Ticket created INC-2026-987: Manual credit granted to acct_0A8EU (30 EUR equiv). Audit required.

jeff: For the code fix — propose: in billing-service, replace check: `if (invoice.total >= promo.min_amount)` with `if (invoice.pre_tax_subtotal_converted >= promo.min_amount)`; add test cases for tax-inclusive locales (DK, NO) and currency conversions. I'll open PR and request quick review.

maya: Thanks. Customer update: "We've applied the promo for me after contacting support, thanks." They want ETA on permanent fix. Can we give a timeline?

jeff: I'll target a hotfix in the next patch (within 48h) and follow with a regression release to ensure other promos unaffected.

sophie: Adding repro notes to ticket INC-2026-987: include curl, API response, account id, and the fact that currency was NOK while promo is defined in EUR.

luis: Also: we should check deferred taxes and OSS cases where tax is 0 but the region is EU — promos shouldn't be blocked. I'll run a sweep for promos failing on accounts with country in EU but currency != EUR.

maya: Perfect. Please cc me on the PR and I'll follow up with the customer. :thumbsup:

jeff: cc @maya. PR link when ready.

billing-bot: Note: please ensure finance approves refunds/credits > 25 EUR per policy.

sophie: Marking thread resolved for support now, will reopen if customer sees any further problems.

maya: Thanks everyone!
